name: Socratic
tagline: A VS Code mentor that guides you toward the answer instead of writing the code for you.

awards: [MLH] Best Use of MongoDB Atlas // [MLH] Meilleure utilisation de MongoDB Atlas

problem: AI coding tools give answers and learners stop learning.
solution: An extension with adaptive help levels, voiced mentor personas, skill tracking and context from your own materials.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask for help and get a hint at your chosen level.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of MongoDB Atlas // [MLH] Meilleure utilisation de MongoDB Atlas” among 260 submissions.
Refuses to just give the answer.

lessons: Limiting what the AI does can be the feature.
